title: fix(ui): record page polish — dates read as dates, Save is the primary, new detail lines start on their defaults, no band above the tabs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuNEeCbXSi4Z8618BgVLuSfe)_

Fixes #35745
Fixes #35816

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no skill text describes the record page's date face, its edit-state buttons or a new detail line's start values; a field's `format` and `defaultValue` keep the meaning the skills already teach

## 维护者速读
- 记录详情页上：日期直接写成日期（悬停才显示"5 天前"），页签上方不再空出一大块，编辑时"保存"成了唯一的实心按钮，主从明细新加的一行一开始就带好默认值、不再一片红。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题，替日常录入和查看记录的业务用户解决读日期要换算、误点取消、新行假报错的问题。
- 出错时最坏是某处日期或按钮样式不对、或新行默认值没带上，保存请求和事务都没动，可以直接撤回本次改动。
- 无。

## What changes

Four record-page fixes, one PR (the two cards were folded by the seat).

**#35745 — business dates as dates.** `DateCellRenderer` gains an `absoluteDate` cell prop: with no declared `format`, the cell writes the date (with its year) and keeps the relative phrase as the `title`, the same face a grid column already uses (`inGridColumn`, #25884). `DetailSection` and `HeaderHighlight` pass it, so the record page's field sections and highlights strip read like the list beside them. A declared `format` (`'relative'` included) still wins; an overdue deadline still reads red, with "Overdue 5d" as the tooltip. A `datetime` field with no `format` already paints the compact absolute face (its cell's default, never the relative phrase); a test now pins that on the record page too. The record footer's created/modified times and card surfaces are untouched.

**#35745 — the band above the tabs.** The page scroller (`RecordDetailView`) and `RecordPageColumns` each padded their top 24px on desktop, stacking a 48px band between the header and the tab row. The scroller now pads sides and bottom only; `RecordPageColumns` keeps a 12px top at every width. The print chrome and the approval-fallback actions bar above the columns take `mt-3` so they keep their spacing. An authored page the page renderer draws (no `RecordPageColumns` root, a print page included) keeps the renderer's own `p-3 md:p-4 lg:p-6`, so it still starts clear of the header (24px on a desktop, from 48); the loading, error, not-found and forbidden states are early returns of the view and never render inside the scroller. Side padding is unchanged.

**#35816 — Save is the primary button.** `sys_record_edit_save` declares `variant: 'primary'`, and `page:header` now lets a host button that declares `variant: 'primary'` be the primary, in the place the host gave it (Cancel, then Save). No other host button declares a variant, so every other header ranks as before.

**#35816 — a new detail line starts on its defaults.** `RecordBodyTableEditor` computes the child object's static defaults with `schemaDefaultValues` (the values a create form seeds) and hands them to `LineItemsField` as `newRowValues`; the ghost line starts on them. A new line's empty required cell reads red only once a save was refused (`newRowRequiredShown`), so the server's reason and the red cell arrive together; a stored line is flagged as before. A line `Add` starts on `newRowValues` carries `UNTOUCHED_NEW_ROW` (a symbol key: `Object.entries`, `JSON.stringify` and so every payload skip it) until its first edit; `isBlankRow` treats a marked line as blank, so a line added and left as it came is skipped at save, while a line the user edited is judged by its values alone and is saved even when every typed value equals a default. `@object-ui/fields` exports `UNTOUCHED_NEW_ROW` and `isUntouchedNewRow`. Server-resolved defaults (`NOW()`, CEL) are left to the server. The batch request and transaction are unchanged.

## Tests

- Added: `DetailSection.dateYear-27520` (#35745: past / today / future date, highlights strip, declared `relative` wins, CONTROL bare cell); `RecordPageColumns` (root padding pinned); `page-header-primary-12617` (#35816: Cancel then Save with Save the only filled button; Save stays primary beside page actions, one declaring `variant: 'primary'` included; CONTROL with no host primary the first page action leads); `GridField` (#35816: Add and the entry line start on the host's values; a line Add started is marked untouched until its first edit, even an edit back to its default; CONTROL with no `newRowValues` no mark; a new line's empty required cell waits for the host's word while a stored line is flagged; CONTROL without that word a new line is flagged at once); `RecordBodyTableEditor.recordEditBatch-35599` (#35816: an untouched new line is skipped, a line with input created with its default; a line edited back to exactly its defaults is created; the mark never reaches a write payload); `DetailSection.dateYear-27520` also pins a `datetime` field reading as its date in a section row and the highlights strip; `RecordDetailView.topInset-35745` (mounted through the view: an authored page pads its own top under a scroller that pads none, CONTROL the scroller keeps sides and foot; a print page's chrome takes its top margin); live e2e `ui/e2e/live/record-page-polish-35745.spec.ts` (showcase Expense Report on the real stack: tabs ≤ 12px under the scroller top, the date and its tooltip, Cancel then Save with Save the only filled button, a new line on Other / Submitted with no red cell, and an added untouched line not stored).
- Migrated: `recordPage.deadlineSettled-11815` — the record page now writes the absolute date, so its text assertions read `formatDate(iso, undefined, { alwaysShowYear: true })` and the relative phrase ("Overdue 5d" / "5 days ago") moved to the tooltip assertion. Same records, same red/settled verdicts.
- Voided: none.
- Ablations (each restored, tree clean): `absoluteDate` removed from `DetailSection` → 3/9 red; `hostPrimary` forced undefined → 2/8 red; `!newRowWaits` removed from `GridField` → 1/54 red; `newRowValues` dropped from `isBlankRow` → 1/7 red. Rework: scroller padding back to `p-3 sm:p-4 lg:p-6` plus print chrome `mt-3` removed → 2/2 red (`topInset-35745`); `DateTimeCellRenderer` default `'compact'` → `'relative'` → 1/10 red; `touched(r)` removed from `GridField`'s edit path plus the mark check removed from `isBlankRow` → 2/64 red; under the live spec, scroller padding back → red (tabs 36px under the scroller top), mark check removed → red (the untouched line is sent, the save is refused, the edit state stays).

## Acceptance notes

- #35853 (header two rows, seat 5) had not landed when this was built, so this is on current `main`; `overlap-check` shows it merging cleanly with #35910 and #35921, the open PRs sharing `RecordDetailView.tsx`. The header and band hunks were done last, and keep off the breadcrumb/frame hunks #35853 changes.
- The branch is a harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-*` name.
- The horizontal double inset (scroller + columns, 48px on each side at desktop) is left as it is; this PR removes only the vertical band the card names.
- On a 375 phone the title block sits inside the page; title block → tabs is 16px (the page's own gap), page top 12px.
- `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` and the save transaction are untouched.
- Follow-up: #35940 (new MasterDetailForm rows: prefill defaults, no early required flags)
- Review rework (L2 record 7050830297, S1–S4): S1 a `datetime` field is pinned absolute; S2 the other pages the scroller hosts are checked and one is pinned through the view; S3 a line is skipped only while untouched, by the mark above, instead of by comparing its values with the defaults; S4 the claimed `ui/e2e` spec is added under `e2e/live`, since the band only shows in real layout. The L2 nit and L1-c's two nits ride #35940.

Read first (by risk): `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (the primary pick — every record header goes through it); `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` (`newRowWaits` in the invalid computation); `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/masterDetailTx.ts` (`isBlankRow`).

Two-minute check: open any Expense Report record, click Edit → the header reads Cancel (outline) then Save (filled); Add line in Expense Lines → the new line shows Other / No / Submitted and no red cell.

## Verification

Browser evidence (light and dark, 1280 desktop and 375 phone, showcase app on a fresh seed) is in the project's evidence folder; readings below.

<details><summary>Browser readings</summary>

- Gap header → tabs: before 48px (92 → 140), after 12px (92 → 104) on four records, light and dark; phone 16px.
- Submitted On (date, no format): Nov 15, 2026 / tooltip "5 days ago"; Nov 19 / "Yesterday"; Nov 20 / "Today"; Nov 25 / "In 5 days" — desktop and 375, light and dark. Footer keeps "Created 9m ago".
- Edit state: Cancel outline then Save filled, desktop header and 375 bottom bar, light and dark.
- New line: prefilled Other / No / Submitted, 0 red cells; Amount only → Save → `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, merchant cell red "Merchant is required", list "Row 3 · Merchant: Merchant is required", still in edit state; Merchant filled → stored with status `submitted`; an untouched added line → save succeeds, no line created.

</details>

- `@object-ui/fields` 308 files / 4688 passed; `@object-ui/plugin-form` 241 / 2697; `@object-ui/plugin-detail` 393 / 3606; `@object-ui/components` 492 / 4733; `@object-ui/app-shell` 2350 / 22040 — all exit 0; `type-check` exit 0 in all five.
- After merging `main` (643fe3bc): the six touched test files plus the `components` tests `main` changed — 12 files / 156 passed; `check:type-check-debt` (with `--re-measure`) OK.
- Rework head `1f0b5268`: `@object-ui/fields` 308 files / 4690 passed; `@object-ui/plugin-form` 241 / 2698; `type-check` of fields, plugin-form, app-shell and `type-check:e2e` exit 0; `DetailSection.dateYear-27520`, `RecordDetailView.topInset-35745`, `RecordDetailView.appendInset-27520` 3 files / 14 passed; the live spec passed against a local showcase stack (1 passed, 9.5s).

</details>

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 40 derived, 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. 39 exit 0 at head `0baf37d5`. On the rework head `1f0b5268` the same 40 re-derived and re-run: 40 exit 0, `vitest run scripts/` included (it completed this time against the built console).
- `overlap-check` on `1f0b5268`: clean against `main` and #35910, #35921, #35938; `check:test-source-alias` and `check:nul-bytes` OK.
